mechanisms.label: Japan carry unwind

The first article indicates that USD/JPY broke support as falling U.S. Treasury yields have strengthened the yen, which runs counter to the mechanism’s expectation of rising Japanese yields and a stronger yen tightening global conditions. The second article reports a rally in Japanese bonds driven by global tech routs that have increased haven demand, suggesting a reversal of outward capital flows into Japan, which is consistent with the mechanism’s outward‑flow reversal component.

This supports the outward‑flow reversal component of the Japan carry‑unwind mechanism, indicating capital inflows into Japan. The article is not official and is sourced via Google News. The snippet and title provide the evidence.
